title: Emeralds Plus
description: A Mod which adds a ton of new features for emeralds.
body:
# 💚 The Emeralds Plus Mod Upgrade your Minecraft experience with powerful new emerald equipment! The **Emeralds Plus Mod** introduces a complete set of **Emerald Armor**, **Emerald Tools**, and the **Emerald Upgrade** smithing template. Emerald equipment is balanced to be **stronger than Diamond** but **slightly weaker than Netherite**, making it the perfect mid-to-late-game gear. > ✨ Exclusive enchantments for Emerald equipment are planned for a future update! --- # ✨ Features - 💚 Emerald Armor Set - ⚔️ Emerald Tool Set - 🔨 Emerald Upgrade Smithing Template - 🏘️ Village Loot Integration - ⚖️ Balanced progression between Diamond and Netherite --- ## 🗺️ Languages | Version | English | Portuguese | Russian | Frensh | German | |------|-------------|------|------|-------------|------| | 0.9.1 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | 0.9.0 | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | --- ## 🔧 Channging the Mod Texture - If you want to change the textures just download the [Default Texture pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/emeraldsplusdefaulttexturepack) and change there textures.I recomment to use the same mod version as the texture pack. --- # 🔨 Emerald Upgrade The **Emerald Upgrade** allows you to upgrade **Diamond Tools** and **Diamond Armor** into their Emerald variants. ### Requirements - Diamond Tool or Armor - 1 Emerald Block - 1 Emerald Upgrade ### How to obtain - 📦 Found in **Weaponsmith** village chests - 🎲 **65% chance** to generate You can also duplicate the Emerald Upgrade:
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Upgrade Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bacf91da6fda64b30fc0cbb042602cda32169a2e.png) ![Emerald Upgrade Crafting 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d497761f2b7e4374a9f48bf530f99af507a4c9f4.png)
--- # ⚔️ Emerald Sword A stronger alternative to the Diamond Sword while remaining slightly weaker than Netherite. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **3% chance** to generate
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Sword Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5195e6bf78096101476463b038c242afeec73ba.png)
--- # 🪓 Emerald Axe A powerful axe balanced between Diamond and Netherite. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **3% chance** to generate
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Axe Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fa006337e2199f537648be1be878476d15e37a2.png)
--- # ⛏️ Emerald Pickaxe Mine faster with an upgraded pickaxe stronger than Diamond. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **3% chance** to generate
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Pickaxe Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cca38e87d57787c799bf8140b8086929a23ad0c2.png)
--- # 🛠 Emerald Shovel The Emerald Shovel offers improved durability and mining speed. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **2% chance** to generate
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Shovel Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4279e83dc2fa8163caeda97f42297893420824d.png)
--- # 🌾 Emerald Hoe A durable farming tool made from emeralds. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **2% chance** to generate
📖 Crafting Recipe ![Emerald Hoe Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fc1d76e0efff0f40c176b18b2140f05c3825b52.png)
--- # 🪖 Emerald Armor The complete Emerald Armor set provides protection between Diamond and Netherite. ### Obtain - 🏘️ Found in Weaponsmith village chests - 🎲 **1% chance** to generate for the boots - 🎲 **2% chance** to generate for the rest of the armor
📖 Crafting Recipes ### Helmet ![Emerald Helmet Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/030f16155948131e3d1a1886c170db3960bbdc94.png) ### Chestplate ![Emerald Chestplate Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d8ae5377ddecc5883f6ecf3d93e7eb0d33776b0.png) ### Leggings ![Emerald Leggings Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/101f6aba3b2765a6eec103009060c075c96784b7.png) ### Boots ![Emerald Boots Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ca8d45393eec995b699b84324804a721a5b4cb3.png)
--- # 🛡️ Emerald Shield A stronger alternative to the normal shield. If you shield one tick before you land on the ground you will take no fall damage.
